BiblicalUsage: Etam = "lair of wild beasts"; 1) a village of the tribe of Simeon; 2) a town in Judah fortified and garrisoned by king Rehoboam of Judah and located between Bethlehem and Tekoa; 3) a cliff; site uncertain
